name: gfit-cli
description: Use the GFIT wellness API from Claude — clients, check-ins, plans, metrics, invoices, and more — by wrapping the gfit-cli tool.
long_description: Exposes the `gfit-cli` command-line client as MCP tools so Claude Desktop can drive the GFIT wellness API. Discover commands (`gfit_list_commands`), read their docs (`gfit_help`), check login (`gfit_auth_status`), sign in (`gfit_login`), and call any of the ~144 endpoints (`gfit_run`). If you're not signed in, a real call opens the GFIT browser sign-in automatically (no password passes through Claude) and you just retry. Reads run directly; write/destructive commands return a `--dry-run` preview unless you pass `confirm: true`, and `*.notice` (sends client email) / `*.delete` are guarded. Requires the gfit-cli binary installed.

tools.name: gfit_list_commands
tools.description: List every gfit-cli command, grouped — the full surface.

tools.name: gfit_help
tools.description: Show one command's API docs: endpoint, auth, and each parameter.

tools.name: gfit_auth_status
tools.description: Show whether gfit-cli is logged in.

tools.name: gfit_login
tools.description: Open the GFIT browser sign-in page when not logged in (no password passes through Claude).

tools.name: gfit_run
tools.description: Run any gfit-cli command. Reads run directly; writes return a dry-run preview unless confirm:true. Opens the sign-in page if not logged in.

gfit_cli_path.title: gfit-cli path
gfit_cli_path.description: Path to the gfit-cli binary. Leave as 'gfit-cli' if it's on your PATH; otherwise an absolute path (e.g. /usr/local/bin/gfit-cli).

api_url.title: GFIT API base URL
api_url.description: Override only for a staging environment; leave as default for production.
